job.job_description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


• Develop and maintain scalable, production-ready AI-powered applications.
• Handle end-to-end development including design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
• Build frontend applications using React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
• Develop backend services and REST APIs using Node.js, Express.js, and Python.
• Integrate LLMs, AI APIs, Hugging Face models, AI agents, and automation workflows.
• Work with MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, and NoSQL databases.
• Integrate third-party APIs, webhooks, and real-time services.
• Debug issues and deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
• Collaborate with AI, product, and engineering teams.




REQUIRED SKILLS


• Strong JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals.
• Hands-on experience with React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and REST APIs.
• Working knowledge of Python and exposure to Java.
• Experience with MongoDB, MySQL, and NoSQL databases.
• Understanding of Git, APIs, authentication, debugging, and application architecture.
• Practical knowledge of AI/LLMs and prompt-based applications.
• Experience or familiarity with Hugging Face.
• Ability to independently handle tasks and deliver projects end to end.




GOOD TO HAVE


• Next.js, Redis, WebSockets, and Microservices.
• RAG, AI Agents, LangChain, Langflow, Ollama, or LlamaIndex.
• AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, GraphQL, RabbitMQ, or CI/CD.
• Agile/Scrum and AI automation workflows




WHAT WERE LOOKING FOR


• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
• Good frontend and backend development knowledge.
• Ability to build and deliver AI-powered applications.
• Strong ownership and accountability.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
• Good written and verbal English communication.
• Willingness to learn and adapt to evolving AI technologies.
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG and AI backend experience, transferable cloud skills, but lacks core frontend stack.
